newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO seen hovering around $120-$124/T.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO seen hovering around $120-$124/T.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices on Wednesday were expected to hover around $120-$124 range with fundamentals assessed to be balanced.
High sulphur, 180 centistoke fuel oil was quoted at $121/$123 per tonne on Monday.
Traders said the recovery in the crude market after the Tuesay's plunge may cause fuel oil prices to rise. But they said swaps levels were a shade lower.
The December swaps were quoted at $119.25/$120.00 lower from $120.00/120.75 on Tuesday.
Despite the lower swaps quotes, traders said prices are unlikely to go below $118 per tonne.
Traders said buying interest have absorbed most South Korean December cargoes.
Chinese bids were still heard at $7 per tonne over Singapore spot quotes on a cost and freight basis to south China against offers at $8.
A trader said he expected bids to start at $120-$121 per tonne. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870-3082)
